Name: Leisure Time ---No More Time Anxiety
Author: neoiw
Description:
[size=4][b] Leisure Time ---(Open-Sourced 开源项目)[/b] [/size]

[size=4]Fair time control for Stardew Valley, solo and multiplayer. Standalone companion module extracted (copied) from Growing Children Expanded; when GCE is installed, this mod retires completely. [/size]


[list]
[*][b][color=#ff0000][size=5]Leisure mode [/size][/color]— host-started clock-freeze sessions with a fair violation rule set. [/b][/*]
[/list][center][b]Sometimes you just want to wander the farm, chat with the townsfolk,
or give someone you like a gift—without being chased by the clock.
Leisure Mode exists for exactly that: to give time back to you.[/b][/center]
[center][b][b]Up to twice per in-game week, the host can start Leisure Mode,
which brings the game clock to a complete stop. During this time-free period, you can:[/b][/b][/center]
[center][b][b]✅ Stroll around freely and talk to NPCs[/b][/b][/center]
[center][b][b]✅ Give gifts up close (always welcome, never restricted)[/b][/b][/center]
[center][b][b]❌ But no work of any kind—brewing, mining, farming, chopping trees, and the like are all off-limits[/b][/b][/center]
[center][b]Any violation ends the Leisure Mode session and lets time flow again.
[/b]
[quote][b] In your downtime, you can visit your neighbors and offer them gifts.
Gifting is not work, nor does it consume the week's leisure allowance.
Spend the rest of your time on a quiet stroll—wander through town, let the sea breeze wash over you.
Stardew Valley is more than just chores on the farm. [/b][/quote]
[/center]
[list]
[*][b][color=#ff0000][size=5]Fair multiplayer pacing[/size] [/color]— every player who meets the vanilla pause condition contributes their share, so opening a menu slows the shared clock just like single-player.[/b][/*]
[/list]Example: In a 4-player session, if 3 players open their inventory, the shared clock slows to 1/4 of its normal speed. If all 4 players open a menu, the clock freezes completely — just like single-player pause. If only 1 player opens a menu, time runs at 3/4 speed.
[list]
[*][b][color=#ff0000][size=5]Synced slow zones [/size][/color][size=3]— when anyone enters Skull Cavern (or any location exposing the vanilla extra-milliseconds field), everyone plays at that pace.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=3]Own menu tab — leisure switch, live flow status, and guide copy about strolls and gifting. No birthday UI, no children features.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=3]Take your time back — a configurable global time scale (5%–500%, GMCM slider), applied solo or online, menus open or not.[/size][/b]
[/*]
[/list]


[line]
适用于《星露谷物语》单人与多人模式。本模组是从 Growing Children Expanded（GCE）中提取（复制）出来的独立配套模块；当安装了 GCE 时，本模组会完全停用。
[heading]功能特性[/heading]
[list]
[*][b][color=#ff0000][size=5]休闲模式[/size][/color] —— 由主机发起的时钟冻结时段，配有一套公平的违规判定规则；[/b]
[center][b]
有时候你只是想在农场里走走，和镇民聊聊天，或者给喜欢的人送份礼物——而不是被时钟追着跑。
休闲模式就是为此而生的——把时间真正还给你。 每周最多两次，主机可以开启休闲模式，让游戏时钟完全停止。
在这段不受时间追赶的时光里，你可以：
✅ 自由闲逛、与 NPC 对话
✅ 近距离赠送礼物（始终不受限制）
❌ 但不能进行任何劳作行为——酿酒、挖矿、种地、砍树等统统禁止
任何违规行为都会结束休闲模式，让时间继续流动。[/b][/center]
[quote][center][b]休闲时可以走近邻居送出礼物；
送礼不算劳作，也不会用掉本周的休闲次数。[/b][/center]
[center][b][b]剩下的时光就交给散步吧：
去镇[/b][b]上串串门，去海边吹吹风，星露[/b][b]谷不只有农活。[/b][/b][/center]
[/quote][/*]
[*][color=#ff0000][size=5][b]公平的多人节奏[/b] [/size][/color]—— 每位满足原版暂停条件的玩家都会贡献自己的那一份，因此打开菜单会像单人模式一样放慢共享时钟。[/*]
[/list][center]举例说明：在一场 4 人联机中，如果 3 位玩家同时打开背包，
共享时钟会降到正常速度的 1/4。如果 4 位玩家都打开菜单，
时间则会完全冻结——就像单人模式的暂停一样。
如果只有 1 位玩家打开菜单，时间会以 3/4 的速度运行。[/center]
[list]
[*][color=#ff0000][size=5][b]同步慢速区域[/b] [/size][/color]—— 当任意玩家进入骷髅洞穴（或任何暴露原版额外毫秒字段的地点）时，所有人都会以该节奏进行游戏。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]独立菜单标签页[/b] —— 包含休闲模式开关、实时流速状态，以及关于散步与送礼的指南说明。不含生日界面，也不含儿童相关功能。[/*]
[*][b]把时间还给你[/b] —— 可配置的全局时间倍率（5%–500%，GMCM 滑块），单人、联机均生效，无论菜单是否打开。 [/*]
[/list]
